convert_tf_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow MobileNetV1 checkpoint to a PyTorch model and save to a directory
build_tf_to_pytorch_map: build a mapping dictionary from TensorFlow weight names to PyTorch model parameters
load_tf_weights_in_mobilenet_v1: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch MobileNetV1 model
get_mobilenet_v1_config: get a MobileNetV1 configuration from a model name string with depth multiplier and image size
run_cli_convert: run the CLI script to convert a TensorFlow MobileNetV1 checkpoint to PyTorch format
